description: Exposure, non-exposure and other reporting data from licensed facilities in Canada is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Public Health Agency of Canada | Agence de la santé publique du Canada. Under the Government of Canada’s Human Pathogens and Toxins Act, facilities where controlled activities with Risk Group 2, 3 or 4 pathogens are carried out must have a pathogen and toxin licence. The licence requires facilities to adhere to specific safety protocols and reporting standards. Coverage: Canada. The portal files it under the publisher Public Health Agency of Canada | Agence de la santé publique du Canada. Its tags are Biosafety, biosecurity, incidents, human pathogens and toxins, HPTA. It offers 26 resource(s) in CSV, TXT. The portal shows 2026-07-20 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Open Government Licence - Canada (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
